programs.description: The magical adventures of fraternal twin genies, Shimmer and Shine, who unintentionally create chaos while attempting to grant wishes for their human best friend, Leah.
Rusty Rivets uses engineering, imagination and resourcefulness to repurpose spare parts and other objects he finds to come up with wild and cool contraptions, and save the day.

A group of six rescue dogs, led by a tech-savvy boy named Ryder, have come together to form a pack. Together they embark on adventures and work as a team in order to protect the community.

Long-running children's series following the adventures, mishaps and friendships of Peppa Pig, her brother George, their parents, and the other animal families who make up their town. Each family is a different species of animal, and Peppa's friends include Rebecca Rabbit, Suzy Sheep and Candy Cat. Each episode features a new adventure, and storylines often help children to understand new emotions and experiences they themselves might encounter growing up.
